detaileddescription.para: GetNextPtr - In order to save space, each bucket is a singly-linked-list. In order to make deletion more efficient, we make the list circular, so we can delete a node without computing its hash. The problem with this is that the start of the hash buckets are not Nodes. If NextInBucketPtr is a bucket pointer, this method returns null: use GetBucketPtr when this happens.

briefdescription.para: GetBucketFor - Hash the specified node ID and return the hash bucket for the specified ID.
